related_questions.question: When is flu season in California?

text_blocks.snippet: Flu season in California typically runs from October through May, with peak activity occurring during the winter months, particularly December through February. While the flu can be detected year-round, these winter months are when the most cases are usually reported.

list.title: Peak Activity:
list.snippet: While the season stretches from October to May, the most intense period for flu activity is generally between December and February.

list.title: Late Start:
list.snippet: In some years, like the 2024-2025 season, flu activity can start later than usual, potentially extending the season.

list.title: Flu Types:
list.snippet: Influenza A typically begins in the fall and peaks in February or March, while Influenza B tends to pick up in March.

list.title: California's Geography:
list.snippet: California's coastal location and numerous ports of entry make it particularly important to monitor flu activity due to potential for international spread, according to the CDPH.

list.title: Vaccination:
list.snippet: Even if you get vaccinated later in the season, it is still recommended, as significant flu activity can continue into May.
